title: AI Product Ad Templates for Photos and Videos | AIVideosUGC
description: Find AI product ad templates for photos and short videos. Choose a style, add one product photo, and get a new asset for your store or social feed.
h1: See It. Recreate It. Launch It.
lead: Need a product ad without planning every shot? Pick a template, add your product photo, and publish a fresh asset for your store or social feed.
card: Ready-made styles for product photos and videos. Pick one and add your product.

faq.q: How do I choose a product ad template?
faq.a: Choose the buyer moment you need: product showcase, product explainer, UGC-style product ad, or social media content.

faq.q: Can I adapt a template to my own product?
faq.a: Yes. Add one product photo and review the generated result before publishing.

faq.q: Which video lengths can I choose?
faq.a: Video jobs are available in 6, 10, 15, and 30 seconds.
Photos are square by default. Crop a downloaded still for a specific placement when needed.

faq.q: Can I use a template for an Amazon listing?
faq.a: Yes. Start with a clean product photo template, then check the current Amazon category rules.

faq.q: Can I add a price, code, or headline?
faq.a: Yes. Add exact campaign text after download in your usual editor.

faq.q: Will the result keep my product shape and color?
faq.a: Use a complete source photo, then compare the result with the item you sell before publishing.

faq.q: Do I need editing experience to start?
faq.a: No. Upload a product photo, choose a template, and download the result for your usual editor.
